Description (in game): All attack spells also have a chance of inflicting status ailments. The ailment inflicted depends on the spell element.
Notes:
Fire: Berserk & Doom
Water: Freeze & Poison
Lightning: Paralysis & Confusion
Wind: Sleep & Silence
Earth: Slow & Stop
Light: Blind & Charm
Dark: Dread & Contagion

Description (in game): All spells cast are performed twice at no extra MP cost.
Strike all enemies with a powerful wind-imbued magical attack.
Notes: Condition: Use Red Magic x13. M.Atk +15%, Speed +15%.

Description (in game): Perform an earth magic attack on a target/all targets.
Perform a wind magic attack on a target/all targets.
Restore 1000 HP to a target.
Notes: Deals fixed damage to undead.

Description (in game): Perform a powerful earth magic attack on a target/all targets.
Perform a powerful wind magic attack on a target/all targets.
Restore 2000 HP to a target.
Notes: Deals fixed damage to undead.

Description (in game): Enables magical attacks to inflict critical hits.
Notes: Critical chance seems to depend on critical stat, same as for regular criticals.

Description (in game): Roughly 25% chance of the user's BP increasing by one when attacked.
Notes: Affected by Luck

Description (in game): Restore 3000 HP to a target.
Notes: Deals fixed damage to undead.

Description (in game): Perform an extremely powerful earth magic attack on a target/all targets.
Perform an extremely powerful wind magic attack on a target/all targets.
Perform an extremely powerful magical attack on a target that combines the powers of earth and wind.
Perform an incredibly powerful earth magic attack on a target.
Perform an incredibly powerful wind magic attack on a target.
Using abilities during battle expends HP instead of MP, but at ten times the MP cost.
Notes: Abilities that depend upon the cost of the move used (e.g. Freehand and Ultima Sword) have their damage increased 10 times

Description (in game): The more successive actions the user performs in a turn, the more damage they will inflict.
Notes: Increases damage by 10% for each action used in the turn. An "action" is considered one command from the menu, so combining with things like e.g. Solid Stance or Multitask to do many things for a single BP does not power Barrage up further. Additive with other damage increasing effects.

Description (in game): X Slayer' abilities are more powerful, and will earn one BP for every critical hit inflicted and enemy killed.
Notes: Raises the damage dealt by effective Slayer attacks from 2.85 to 4, or a 5.2x multiplier including family weakness. Bonus BP from kills and criticals only applies when the slayer is effective against the family, if a crit is also a killing blow you will gain 2 BP.

Description (in game): Strike a single enemy with a powerful physical attack.
Notes: Condition: Use Hunting x13. Evasion +50%.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on a target. Particularly effective against Insect family monsters.
Notes: Against Insect family, multiplier rises to 2.85x before factoring in family weakness being hit, 3.7x including family weakness

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on a target. Particularly effective against Plant family monsters.
Notes: Against Plant family, multiplier rises to 2.85x before factoring in family weakness being hit, 3.7x including family weakness

Description (in game): Attempt to paralyse a target.
Perform a physical attack on a target. Particularly effective against Beast family monsters.
Notes: Against Beast family, multiplier rises to 2.85x before factoring in family weakness being hit, 3.7x including family weakness

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on a target. Particularly effective against Aquatic family monsters.
Notes: Against Aquatic family, multiplier rises to 2.85x before factoring in family weakness being hit, 3.7x including family weakness

Description (in game): The user is always able to evade physical counter abilities. Does not apply to magic and certain other abilities.
Perform 5-8 quick physical attacks on random targets. Extra damage will be dealt to paralysed foes.
Notes: Exact damage of each hit varies, in order: 0.45 + 0.4 + 0.5 + 0.45 + 0.4 + 0.45 + 0.5 + 0.45. Damage ratio becomes 0.8x for all hits against Paralysed foes. Average damage ratio is about 2.9x normally, rising to around 5.2x against paralysed foes. Damage is not reduced against groups.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on a target. Particularly effective against Humanoid family monsters.
Notes: Against Humanoid family, multiplier rises to 2.85x before factoring in family weakness being hit, 3.7x including family weakness

Description (in game): The user becomes more likely to inflict critical hits, and also immune to blindness when BP are at one or higher.
Notes: Critical buff seems to be around +30 critical chance, give or take. Both effects only take effect while BP is 1 or above. Note that you need at least 1 BP remaining after braving to benefit from the critical bonus (braving to 0 BP or lower will remove the critical buff).

Description (in game): Perform two physical attacks that are extremely effective against slowed targets.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 4x per hit against Slowed foes (4x normal damage). Not affected by Apex Predator.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on a target. Particularly effective against Undead family monsters.
Notes: Against Undead family, multiplier rises to 2.85x before factoring in family weakness being hit, 3.7x including family weakness

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on a target. Particularly effective against Demon family monsters.
Notes: Against Demon family, multiplier rises to 2.85x before factoring in family weakness being hit, 3.7x including family weakness

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on a target. Particularly effective against Spirit family monsters.
Notes: Against Spirit family, multiplier rises to 2.85x before factoring in family weakness being hit, 3.7x including family weakness

Description (in game): Bow aptitude is increased to S.
Perform 5-8 quick physical attacks on all targets. Extra damage will be dealt to paralysed foes.
Notes: Exact damage of each hit varies, in order: 0.85 + 0.75 + 0.65 + 0.75 + 0.75 + 0.65 + 0.8 + 0.85. Damage ratio becomes 1.8x for all hits against Paralysed foes. Average damage ratio is about 4.85x normally, rising to around 11.7x against paralysed foes.

Description (in game): The user will step in to take damage in place of allies who are close to death, automatically adopting the Default stance in the process. Certain status ailments may render this ability ineffective.
Notes: Activates when an ally is below 20% health. Covers them from all attacks including self inflicted and AoE attacks. Disabled by abilities that prevent the user selecting actions, e.g. Freeze, Charm, Sleep, Berserk, Stop. Does not trigger abilities reliant on defaulting, only the damage reduction aspect of Defaulting is used.

Description (in game): Performing Protect Ally, Bodyguard or Defender of the People restores a little MP, and grants the user an additional BP.
Notes: Restores 1 BP and 10% of max MP

Description (in game): Increase all allies' physical and magical defence for three turns.
Notes: Condition: Use Shieldcraft x12. P.Atk +15%. Grants +30% P.Def and M.Def at job level 11, rising to +100% at job level 15

Description (in game): The user will step in to take damage in place of a selected ally, automatically adopting the Default stance in the process.
Notes: Covers them from all attacks including self inflicted and AoE attacks. Disabled by abilities that prevent the user selecting actions, e.g. Freeze, Charm, Sleep, Berserk, Stop. Does not trigger abilities reliant on defaulting, only the damage reduction aspect of Defaulting is used. Not affected by Across the Board.

Description (in game): Allows a shield to be equipped in each hand. Doing so increases aim by 100%.
Notes: Shields default to L hand first. The +100% aim is misleading, that is the default aim of being unarmed, so your aim won't visibly change when equipping two shields. While dual wielding shields you cannot use basic attacks.

Description (in game): Attempt to blind all targets.
Defaulting does not increase BP, but does nullify all status ailments except slow, stop and doom.
Notes: Provides immunity to elemental weakness, Daub, Instant Death, Berserk, Freeze, Poison, Paralysis, Confusion, Sleep, Silence, Blind, Charm, Dread & Contagion, but only when defaulting. Note that this does not apply to automatic defaulting such as from Protect Ally, Bodyguard and Defender of the People.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack that's extremely effective on frozen targets.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 6x when striking frozen foes (6x normal damage)

Description (in game): For five turns, 50% of any damage received by the user will also be inflicted on the attacker.
Notes: Only one of Reprisal and Harsh Reprisal can be active at a time (most recently used takes priority)

Description (in game): Take up to three attacks in place of allies before the user's next turn, automatically adopting the Default stance in the process. Does not apply to attacks that target all allies.
Notes: Covers allies from self inflicted attacks. Disabled by abilities that prevent the user selecting actions, e.g. Freeze, Charm, Sleep, Berserk, Stop. Does not trigger abilities reliant on defaulting, only the damage reduction aspect of Defaulting is used.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack on a target. The heavier the equipment in the user's left hand, the greater the damage inflicted.
Notes: Damage scaling ratio depends on weight of L hand equipment, scaling is 1.3 + 0.2 x weight. Bows are treated as not being in the L hand, so have 0 weight for Heavy Hitter.

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack that's extremely effective on confused targets.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 6x when striking confused foes (6x normal damage)

Description (in game): Any speed reductions caused by equipment in either hand become speed bonuses instead.
Physical and magical defence increase with BP, but will also decrease when BP drop below zero.
Notes: 10% increase/decrease per BP. Unlike most other passives, this bonus is multiplicative with in battle buffs rather than additive. e.g. if you have 400 P.Def and 2 BP, and a +50% in battle buff, you would have 720 P.Def (400 x 1.2 x 1.5). However this is still capped at 999 P.Def

Description (in game): Donates 33% of the user's max. MP to a target. If MP is below 33% of max. level, all available MP will be donated.
Notes: Cost drops when below 33% of max MP to be equal to current MP.

Description (in game): Perform two physical attacks on a target. The heavier the equipment in both the user's hands, the greater the damage inflicted.
Notes: Damage scaling ratio depends on weight of both hand equipment, scaling is (1.4 + weight x 0.13) per hit.

Description (in game): Boost MP and magical attack for three turns by an amount based on the user's encumbrance. Any negative effects of being overburdened are ignored.
Notes: Increases max MP by 0.7% per point of weight, and provides a temporary M.Atk buff equal to weight. These buffs adjust whenever you increase or decrease your weight. While penalties from being overburdened may be removed, the regular weight penalties to turn order still exist.

Description (in game): For three turns, 100% of any damage received by the user will also be inflicted on the attacker.
Notes: Only one of Reprisal and Harsh Reprisal can be active at a time (most recently used takes priority)

Description (in game): Using Artistry abilities on oneself costs nothing, and will cause positive instead of negative effects.
Notes: Only the debuff effects are turned into positive effects - damaging spells such as Chiaro, Scuro and Brush With Death still inflict negative effects, and Splatter still inflicts Daub. Allies having Self-Expression has no effect on them taking negative effects, even if used with e.g. Mass Production.

Description (in game): All status effects instigated by the user last a turn longer.
Notes: Affects numerical buffs and debuffs as well as general status effects such as Mass Production

Description (in game): Decrease all enemies' physical and magical attack and defence for three turns. Chance of inflicting the 'daub' status effect.
Notes: Condition: Use Artistry x12. M.Def +20%, Res Pow +20%. Inflicts P.Atk, P.Def, M.Atk and M.Def -21% at level 1, -35% at job level 15.

Description (in game): Reduce a target's physical attack by 10% for four turns. Stats cannot be reduced below 65% of their base value.
Attempt to daub a target. Targets' resistance to all elements and weapon types is reduced by one when daubed.
Notes: Daub seems to make enemies always take vulnerable damage from physical attacks.

Description (in game): Reduce a target's magical attack by 10% for four turns. Stats cannot be reduced below 65% of their base value.
Remove various status effects from a target.
Notes: Removes buffs, debuffs, Daub and Elemental Impariment. Does not affect other status ailments. May affect other things. Identical to Freelancer's Square One as far as I can tell.

Description (in game): Reduce a target's restorative power by 10% for four turns. Stats cannot be reduced below 65% of their base value.
Inflict ten times the ability's casting cost as magical damage 1-5 times on a random target.
Notes: Is not considered magic for the purpose of skills. Damage dealt scales with units spent on cost. If cost is reduced (e.g. through MP Saver), damage dealt also drops. If HP/MP Converter is used, damage is increased proportionally. Magic damage scaling bonuses multiply damage, for example Work Your Magic and Dirty Fighter.

Description (in game): Reduce a target's physical defence by 10% for four turns. Stats cannot be reduced below 65% of their base value.
Reduce a target's magical defence by 10% for four turns. Stats cannot be reduced below 65% of their base value.
The BP cost of using sub-job abilities is reduced by one.
Notes: Only affects BP cost moves. If combined with Up To No Good, BP cost reduction applies first, meaning the abilities cost 40 MP less.

Description (in game): Perform a powerful light magic attack on a target.
Notes: Is not considered magic for the purpose of skills.

Description (in game): Perform a powerful dark magic attack on a target.
Notes: Is not considered magic for the purpose of skills.

Description (in game): Taking damage will cause the user's MP to be restored by a proportional amount.
Notes: Only triggered on attack damage. Damage from other sources such as reprisal type counters, Bloody Minded or Poison do not trigger Convert MP. Lethal damage also does not trigger the ability.

Description (in game): The more status ailments a target is afflicted with, the more damage is inflicted when attacking that target.
Notes: Does not count elemental impairment as a status ailment, but does count all other status ailments.

Description (in game): Attempt to inflict the doom ailment on a target. If the target is immune to doom or instant death attacks, they will receive a set amount of magical damage instead.
Notes: If target is immune to death they take 1000 magic damage. If they are immune to death but not doom, they will take both the damage and have doom inflicted

Description (in game): For three turns, the user's Artistry abilities can be applied to multiple targets.
Notes: Applies to all Pictomancer abilities except Mass Production
